messages:
lee: Hey team, opening an escalation — customer tenant `acme-inc` says their compliance export for March is missing ~40% of events and the export job keeps failing with a 502. They flagged this as urgent for an audit tomorrow.

maya: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Any error payloads or repro steps from the export UI?

lee: From the customer: they run the export from Console > Compliance > Exports => select date range => Start export. The job initially shows queued then `failed`. They shared the job id: export-0x4f2. Attached log snippet: 
```
2026-03-12T09:12:41Z export-0x4f2 ERROR export/service.go:142 export failed: upstream 502 bad gateway
2026-03-12T09:12:41Z export-0x4f2 ERROR kms: decrypt: status=403 err="access denied"
2026-03-12T09:12:41Z export-0x4f2 WARN cache: prefix-miss for tenant acme-inc
```
They also say their SSO admin recently changed role mappings.

anton: 502 + KMS 403 smells like a key access issue when service tries to decrypt tenant archive key. Which KMS wrapper do they use? Cloud KMS or HSM?

lee: Customer uses our KMS integration with their cloud KMS (GCP). They confirmed key IAM was touched last week.

maya: @anton can you check the export worker logs for that job id and correlate with the KMS client logs? I can take repro steps if we need to re-run export in staging with their tenant snapshot.

anton: Pulling logs now. Quick check: export worker threw a KMS permission denied at 09:12:41, then retried twice, then bubbled to 502. Worker log: 
```
[export-worker-7] 2026-03-12T09:12:41Z decrypt(client_id=svc-exporter, tenant=acme-inc) -> PERMISSION_DENIED
[export-worker-7] 2026-03-12T09:12:41Z attempt=2 -> PERMISSION_DENIED
[export-worker-7] 2026-03-12T09:12:42Z export aborted -> upstream=502
```
Looks like the service principal lost decrypt rights for the tenant key.

aurora: If the KMS IAM changed, we need to treat this as a compliance incident — missing audit events + inability to produce export = regulatory risk. @lee please collect the export job metadata and tag incident severity. I'll open an internal audit ticket.

lee: Done — incident tagged sev=high and created ticket CI-2026-142. Customer notified we have a triage in progress.

maya: For immediate repro: I can spin up a staging export using a snapshot of acme-inc (anonymized) and simulate role-removal to verify behavior. Need to coordinate with infra to get a KMS test key with similar policy.

anton: Also found a related issue: SCIM provisioning logs show a role mapping update around 2026-03-11T22:05 which removed `compliance_exporter` from the tenant service account for acme-inc. SCIM change log: 
```
2026-03-11T22:05:12Z user=automation-sso role_update tenant=acme-inc removed=[compliance_exporter] changed_by=admin@acme.com
```
That explains why the service principal no longer has decrypt rights — role anchor got removed via SCIM mapping.

aurora: Can we confirm whether that SCIM update came from the customer's IdP push or from an internal admin action? If it's IdP-initiated, we need to provide proof for their audit log.

lee: Customer says they made a deliberate role cleanup in their IdP. They didn't expect it to affect export because they thought service principals were excluded.

maya: Two parallel actions: (1) recovery path — restore compliance_exporter role to the tenant service principal and re-run exports for the missing date range; (2) long-term — add guardrails so SCIM role changes that remove critical service roles require a confirmation modal and an audit note.

anton: I've re-applied the role binding in a staging mirror and confirmed decrypt succeeds: 
```
2026-03-12T11:03:02Z decrypt -> OK key=projects/..../keys/acme-inc-archive
2026-03-12T11:03:03Z export-0x4f2 replay job started
```
Still need prod change approval for the restore.

aurora: For the audit trail, we should also collect the SCIM delta + SAML logs showing the admin user who triggered the sync. I will request the raw SCIM webhook payloads from the SCIM ingestion service and timestamped SAML assertion logs. Keep everything attached to CI-2026-142.

lee: Noted. Customer agreed to temporary role restore while they review IdP settings. They want confirmation that exports will be re-run and hashes will match.

maya: On re-run — we should do a deterministic replay of the export job once keys are accessible to avoid double-counting. I'll coordinate with export service to run in replay mode and produce signed manifests for the CSV.

opsbot: deploy-bot: rollout request queued: patch/export-replay-job v1.2.3 -> requires on-call approval.

anton: I'll request prod change approval and schedule the re-run in the next maintenance window. ETA for completed export + manifests: 6 hours after approval.

aurora: Good. For compliance, we must provide: (a) before/after role mapping snapshot, (b) SCIM webhook payloads, (c) SAML assertion log showing admin identity, (d) KMS audit entries showing denied then allowed decrypts, (e) proof of re-run with hashes. I'll compile and attach to the ticket.

lee: Customer updated: they will keep the temp role for 24 hours while they finish internal review. I'll post status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — moving to action items.

lee: Closing notes: root cause = SCIM-driven removal of compliance_exporter role -> KMS decrypts denied -> export job failed -> missing audit export. Recovery: role restore + deterministic replay.

aurora: Marking this for post-incident review with devex to add SCIM guardrail UI.

lee: End of thread.
